Name: Enigmo
Description: A physics puzzler: place bumpers, sliders and sponges to steer falling droplets of water, oil and lava into their vessels.

Achievements.Name: Efficient
Achievements.Description: Complete a level with 1 or more unused pieces.

Achievements.Name: Spare Parts
Achievements.Description: Complete a level with 2 or more unused pieces.

Achievements.Name: Were Those Important
Achievements.Description: Complete a level with 4 or more unused pieces.

Achievements.Name: Better Than Nothing
Achievements.Description: Finish a level with between 0 and 100 bonus points.

Achievements.Name: Dedicated Dropper
Achievements.Description: Play 20 consecutive levels in one session.
